captions.caption: An instrumental track that starts out with dreamy string instruments, flutes and synths over an upbeat hip hop beat, while in the second half, a piano kicks in and gets more dominant and dynamic throughout, evoking melancholic feelings.
An emotional instrumental piece consisting of electronic instruments of piano, drums and violin.
